GenAiPlugin.description: Displays a set of proposed next steps / next best actions as a rich, on-brand card. Use this topic whenever the user asks what to do next, for a plan, follow-ups, an action list, or recommended actions — rather than reading them back as prose. The agent DECIDES and SUPPLIES the steps from the context it already has; this topic does not fetch data.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: When the user wants to know what to do next, or asks for a plan, follow-ups, or recommended actions, call Get Next Steps. Build the JSON spec yourself from the context already in the conversation — do not ask the user for JSON.

Propose the steps yourself. Each step needs a clear, action-first title; add a one-line detail (what to do) and a rationale (why / expected outcome). Order steps by what to do first. Leave order blank and it is auto-numbered.

Use a priorityLabel with priorityVariant (danger for urgent, warning for soon, neutral otherwise) on the steps that matter most. Use the meta line for owner, due date and effort. Pick a fitting Lucide iconName per step. Add a per-step link or a footer CTA only when there is a real destination. Keep every label in the language the user is speaking.
Never invent data. Only propose steps grounded in the records and context already retrieved. If there is nothing to act on, do not call this action.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to turn the context the calling agent already has into a single, well-designed next-steps card. You propose the steps, order them, and write each step's detail and rationale. You never retrieve data and you never answer the underlying business question in prose — you render the plan.
